I've replied to Hollis in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

It comes from his own message in #central-team on Jun 9, a channel he's in. He wrote there that the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to PD-4821.

I also passed on his caveat from that day, in case it's still open: the import file labels the doors E1/E2 but Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs sorting out before anyone reimports, or they'll create duplicates. A ticket number is an operational fact and Hollis is the Central team lead, so it was fine to share it there.
